      "observations": [
        "All six owned diffs were read. Six send sites in five test files replace compose-window-close waits, including one synthesized Send Later shortcut, with send_later. The helper installs domWindowOpened before goDoCommand and chains domWindowClosed for that window. The helper therefore awaits the observed window lifecycle; it does not explicitly await compose-window closure, delivery success, Outbox content, or leak cleanup.",
        "The helper has no window URI predicate and no preference push. Its intended next window is the send progress dialog under the app default show_send_progress=true. Actual command dispatch calls the async SendMessageLater without returning its promise; the action itself awaits recipient conversion and GenericSendMessage(Later). The helper supplies an event-based completion boundary rather than using the command return value.",
        "All five current test consumers and relevant historical postconditions were read. Attachment reminder selects/deletes an Outbox message after the helper; its no-alert expectation is a comment rather than a new direct assertion. Blocked-content, inline-image, invalid-data-URI, free-text-link and format checks remain separate direct content assertions after Outbox selection/loading. No new assertions are added by this change; existing unrelated assertion wording is not rewritten.",
        "The shared helper JSDoc names the progress open/close action, but its async function has no explicit result value and no success-status check. Preserve that boundary when calling it. The inline-image caller still needs focus/message loading, and format tests retain their separate display timing. Current pref-env conversion and later date-sort waits are not changes in this owned phase.",
        "Manual style: the command is between promise registration and await, with blank lines separating the helper from adjacent methods and later content checks. Repeated sequential await calls express scenario order; parallelizing them would change the tests. The explicit helper name replaces duplicated action/wait sequences without turning a harness exception into production guidance.",
        "Full primary Bug1996976 context is reused from this group’s completed3939 audit, with exact ID/digest and original reader; no second body read. Own D270418 full context is reused from collection. The author says these fixes do not fully resolve leaks and leaves product/test causation open. Remote build completion and landing are historical, not a new leak or platform result."
